name: Keystone Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sets the keystone of the blow so the whole force lands on one point.

name: Keystone Ward
description: Seat the keystone of the guard in the forearms so every other line of the guard bears on it.

name: Keystone Stride
description: Move so that the keystone foot never leaves its place and the other swings round it.

name: Keystone Press
description: Press a keystone of sealed qi into the foe's chest so the channels round it lock one after another.

name: Keystone Spear
description: Thrust a narrow keystone of qi through the guard to the point where the whole stance rests.

name: Keystone Mend
description: Set a keystone of sealed qi in a broken place to hold the damage steady in yourself or an ally.

name: Fixed Keystone
description: Fix a keystone in the foe's field so every technique he starts is held back at the first step.

name: Keystone Fall
description: Bring the whole keystone down on the foe in one blow that carries every sealed layer behind it.

name: Unmoved Keystone
description: Set the keystone of the whole stance so no technique below its tier can move the user or seize him.

name: Ironbound Fist
description: Punch with a fist banded in iron-hard sealed qi that does not give at the moment of impact.

name: Ironbound Guard
description: Bind the forearms in rings of sealed qi so a blow meets a limit it cannot pass.

name: Ironbound Step
description: Step with the weight banded down so the stance cannot be shifted by any push.

name: Ironbound Turn
description: Hold the banded forearm out and let a heavy blow break its line against the iron.

name: Ironbound Seal
description: Band a chain of seals round the foe's chest that keeps his qi from rising above the throat.

name: Ironbound Press
description: Press the foe's qi down with a banded palm until the weaker techniques will not rise at all.

name: Ironbound Cleanse
description: Band a tainted limb in sealed qi and wring the poison out along the arm of yourself or an ally.

name: Ironbound Lock
description: Lock the foe's strongest channel in iron bands so the technique that runs in it is dead.

name: Ironbound Burst
description: Burst every band of the stance outward at once in a ring that flings back all foes near.

name: Ironbound Limit
description: Cap all the foe's accessible power at the level of his weakest technique for the length of a fight.

name: Casket Palm
description: Strike with a palm that shuts the sealed qi in the chest like the lid of a casket.

name: Casket Ward
description: Close a casket of sealed qi round the body so a blow reaches nothing that lives.

name: Casket Stride
description: Carry the closed shell with each step so the body crosses ground inside its own seal.

name: Casket Turn
description: Close the lid of the guard on a strike and turn it off along the shut edge.

name: Casket Press
description: Close a small casket of qi round the foe's hand so he cannot open the fingers.

name: Casket Pierce
description: Drive a sealed point through the shell of the guard and open it from within.

name: Casket Mend
description: Close a wound inside a small casket of qi and keep it shut until the flesh has knit.

name: Closing Casket
description: Leave a hidden casket of qi on the ground that shuts over the first foe to step into it.

name: Casket Seal
description: Seal the foe inside his own stance so he can neither advance nor cast for many breaths.

name: Sealed Casket
description: Lock a whole volume of space round the foe so that he and all within it are held in place.

name: Brandmark Fist
description: Punch with a fist that brands a mark of sealed qi into the point struck.

name: Brandmark Guard
description: Burn a brand into the air before the body that turns a strike aside on contact.

name: Brandmark Step
description: Leave a faint brand at each footfall and step through the line they make.

name: Brandmark Turn
description: Mark the attacking arm in passing and turn it with the brand so it lands wide.

name: Brandmark Reading
description: Read the brands left on a body and learn which seals are set and how long they hold.

name: Brandmark Seal
description: Brand the foe's wrist with a mark that locks the qi flowing through the hand.

name: Brandmark Pierce
description: Burn a narrow brand straight through the guard and into the flesh beneath.

name: Brandmark Cleanse
description: Burn a clean brand round a cursed wound to seal the curse away from the rest of the body.

name: Deep Brandmark
description: Sink a brand to the root of the foe's qi so every technique he casts is hampered.

name: Brandmark Flare
description: Flare every brand in the area at once in a burst that scorches those who bear them.

name: Brand Rupture
description: Break the brand on the foe from within so the sealed qi tears free through the body past any guard.

name: Padlock Palm
description: Strike with a palm that snaps a padlock of qi shut over the nearest joint.

name: Padlock Guard
description: Snap a padlock of qi across the crossed forearms so the guard cannot be pried open.

name: Padlock Step
description: Lock the rear foot to the ground at each step and pivot freely on the locked point.

name: Padlock Hold
description: Pass a padlock of qi through the foe's guard and snap it shut round his wrist.

name: Padlock Strike
description: Drive the shackle of the padlock through a gap in the guard as a hard narrow point.

name: Padlock Mend
description: Snap a padlock of qi over a bleeding wound to hold it closed in yourself or an ally.

name: Padlock Seal
description: Close a padlock on the foe's central channel so no technique can pass through it.

name: Padlock Shield
description: Hang a great padlock before yourself and your allies that no hand can pry open.

name: Great Padlock
description: Close a great padlock of sealed qi round one foe so he cannot move or cast while it holds.

name: Hushbound Palm
description: Strike with a palm that lays a hush on the point struck and muffles the qi there.

name: Hushbound Ward
description: Bind the air before the body in a hush so a blow arrives without its weight.

name: Hushbound Step
description: Cross the ground in hushed steps that leave no sound and no trace of qi.

name: Hushbound Turn
description: Take a blow on a hushed forearm and turn it with no clash and no warning.

name: Hushbound Seal
description: Seal the foe's mouth and breath in a hush so he cannot call a word of power.

name: Hushbound Press
description: Press a hush into the foe's field that slows every technique he tries to gather.

name: Hushbound Mend
description: Hush the pain and the bleeding of a deep wound together in yourself or an ally.

name: Hushbound Lock
description: Lock the foe in a hush so deep that no technique stirs in him for many breaths.

name: Hushbound Wave
description: Roll a wave of hush outward that stuns the qi of every foe it crosses.

name: Absolute Hush
description: Let a total hush fall on the field so that no foe in it may speak or cast.

name: Oathbar Fist
description: Punch with a fist that carries a sworn bar of qi into the body and holds it there.

name: Oathbar Guard
description: Drop a sworn bar across the guard so a blow cannot force it.

name: Oathbar Step
description: Step with the bar carried across the front and plant it where the next blow must land.

name: Oathbar Turn
description: Swing the bar up against a strike and throw it high over the shoulder.

name: Oathbar Draw
description: Bar the qi in the lower belly behind a sworn word and let it out in one strong measure.

name: Oathbar Seal
description: Drop a sworn bar across the foe's main channel so his qi cannot cross it.

name: Oathbar Pierce
description: Drive the end of the bar through the guard in a single hard thrust.

name: Oathbar Cleanse
description: Bar a spreading poison at the wrist and push it back out through the skin of yourself or an ally.

name: Held Oathbar
description: Hold the bar across the foe's field so no technique goes past it while the oath is kept.

name: Oathbar Cover
description: Spread the bar wide over yourself and allies so heavy blows are stopped at its length.

name: Oathbar Return
description: Hold the last breath of one lately dead behind the bar so it cannot leave and then call it back.

name: Holdfast Palm
description: Strike with a palm that clings to the body struck and holds its qi in place.

name: Holdfast Guard
description: Anchor the guard to the ground through the legs so a blow cannot shift the stance.

name: Holdfast Step
description: Plant each foot with a hook of qi and pull the body past it in a steady line.

name: Holdfast Seal
description: Anchor a seal in the foe's lower belly so his qi cannot gather there.

name: Holdfast Press
description: Press the foe's stance flat and hold it down so he cannot rise or leap.

name: Holdfast Mend
description: Anchor a broken bone in place with sealed qi so it heals straight in yourself or an ally.

name: Deep Holdfast
description: Sink the anchor deep through the legs so the whole body bears a blow as a mountain bears rain.

name: Holdfast Lock
description: Anchor the foe's feet to the ground with a seal so he cannot step or leap.

name: Absolute Holdfast
description: Anchor the whole stance so the user cannot be moved or seized by any technique below its tier.

name: Runelock Palm
description: Strike with a palm that cuts a small rune of sealed qi into the point of contact.

name: Runelock Guard
description: Cut a rune in the air before the body and let a blow break on its lines.

name: Runelock Step
description: Step along runes cut on the ground and finish at the last stroke of the sign.

name: Runelock Turn
description: Draw one rune across an incoming blow and turn it along the stroke's line.

name: Runelock Reading
description: Read the runes of sealed qi laid on a person or a place and know what they hold.

name: Runelock Seal
description: Cut a rune into the foe's arm that locks the technique running through it.

name: Runelock Pierce
description: Cut a rune of piercing qi straight through the guard to the body behind.

name: Runelock Mend
description: Cut a rune of mending over a wound to close it and keep it closed for yourself or an ally.

name: Runelock Cleanse
description: Cut a rune of cleansing over the blood to lock a poison out of yourself or an ally.

name: Runelock Brand
description: Cut a deep rune into the foe's chest that locks one technique for the whole fight.

name: Runelock Burst
description: Break a ring of runes outward in a blast that strikes every foe near.

name: Great Runelock
description: Cut a great rune that locks all the foe's techniques that share one source until it fades.

name: Wardstone Fist
description: Punch with a fist as heavy as a wardstone and leave its weight in the target.

name: Wardstone Guard
description: Plant a wardstone of qi before the body that a blow breaks upon.

name: Wardstone Step
description: Set each foot like a wardstone and pivot over it into the next position.

name: Wardstone Turn
description: Let a blow strike the stone of the forearm and glance off to the side.

name: Wardstone Seal
description: Set a small wardstone against the foe's ribs that locks the breath behind it.

name: Wardstone Press
description: Lay a wardstone on the foe's field and press his rising qi flat beneath it.

name: Wardstone Cleanse
description: Set a wardstone on the course of a taint to stop it and drain it out of the body.

name: Wardstone Lock
description: Plant four wardstones of qi about a spot so the ground between them holds any foe who enters.

name: Wardstone Shield
description: Raise a standing wardstone before yourself and your allies that takes heavy blows without a crack.

name: Standing Wardstone
description: Plant a great wardstone that locks every technique cast within its field for as long as it stands.
